title: The rooftop garden record
paragraphs: Every Tuesday, the eco-club meets on the school roof. During the previous term, it {{1}} only once a month, so the plants did not receive enough attention. One wooden planter stood near the stairwell, but volunteers built four more {{2}} during the holidays.

Before each session, the club leader checks the watering chart and {{3}} the weather forecast. Water normally drains through small holes in each container. After a storm last week, the excess water had already {{4}} away before the students arrived.

The eastern side of the roof is bright for most of the morning. After the club installed a reflective panel, the western side became even {{5}} than before. The seedlings there grew quickly, and their unexpected {{6}} convinced the club to add another bed.

At the end of each visit, students measure the height of the young plants. These careful {{7}} help the group compare one week with the next. Although the club first relied on a teacher to arrange every visit, the students now organise the schedule by {{8}}.
